about_pullquote: We supply the best brands and fit them right, first time, every time.
about_para_1: Derby Bathroom & Heating was established in 2006 with a simple mission: bring quality bathrooms and reliable heating systems within reach of Derby families and businesses. Over 18 years, we've grown from a small showroom to a trusted local name, supplying and fitting thousands of bathrooms, boilers, and heating systems across the city and surrounding areas. Our combined experience spans bathroom design, plumbing, heating installation, and customer care.
about_para_2: We're known for honest advice, competitive pricing, and workmanship that lasts. Unlike national chains, we get to know our customers and remember them — repeat business makes up half our work. Our showroom at Upper Dale Road displays the latest suites, radiators, and heating solutions, and our fitters are fully trained on every product we supply.
reviews_heading: What Derby Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant from start to finish. Paul and his team ripped out our old bathroom and installed a new suite in two days. Quality finish, tidy, professional. Can't fault them. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Called about a broken boiler mid-winter. They came out within 24 hours, diagnosed the problem straight away, and had a replacement fitted the next day. Fair price too. Legend.
reviews.author: Diane P.

reviews.text: Fantastic showroom. Staff knew their stuff and didn't push me towards the most expensive option. Got a gorgeous bathroom suite and they installed it perfectly. Will be using them again for our upstairs.
reviews.author: Sarah M.
